_about: Stated facts that decide a PAC's group where the FEC fields and the IRS master file don't (scripts/refresh/lib/sponsors.mjs). Each is a fact about the sponsor, checkable by anyone; 'ein' names the sponsor's IRS record where it was found by hand, for the people test. Added 2026-10-11 (final candidate) and 2026-10-12 (FINAL-2); the owner reviews the list.

C00570226.fact: Checked under rule 11: the FEC lists it as a hybrid PAC with no connected organization.
